description: A wielder of magic derived from a bargain with an extraplanar entity.

features.name: Otherworldly Patron
features.tldr: Forge a pact with a supernatural entity that grants you magical power and features.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.tldr: Cast spells using Charisma that always recharge on a short or long rest at maximum slot level.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.tldr: Gain fragments of forbidden knowledge that grant you permanent magical augmentations and abilities.

features.name: Pact Boon
features.tldr: Your patron bestows a special gift, such as a bound weapon, a tome of secrets, or a familiar.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Otherworldly Patron Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Otherworldly Patron.
